segments.text: Give the course roadmap first: students will learn programming concepts, practical coding skills, and problem solving through repeated practice.
Ask what a computer fundamentally does. Contrast storing information with performing calculations, and stress that a computer follows instructions.
Use a familiar prize drawing as a concrete example. A fact is declarative knowledge, while a recipe of steps is imperative knowledge.
Demonstrate the recipe in Python code and invite students to predict the output before running each line.
Introduce types and variables with small arithmetic examples, then check what changes when two different types are combined.
Summarize computation as primitive operations composed into algorithms, and ask students to transfer the idea to an everyday task.
